Conversation 2 edges it by actually checking the key unknowns (water ingress, cap seating), explicitly confirming it was safe to plug back in, and giving a clear escalation path ('if clicking returns, switch off at the plug and call an engineer') with no part push at all. Conversation 2's minor inaccuracies ('flame detection', 'wet thermocouple') and slightly redundant gas-off step keep the margin small.
